prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Creating Your Desktop Pet", "We are preparing your companion's high-resolution desktop animations and behaviors.", "Rendering pet assets...", "Your pet will live on your desktop and can be moved anytime."]
1: ["Meet Your Companion", "Select a desktop pet companion to bring to life on your screen.", "Ready for Desktop"]
2: ["Desktop Setup Verification", "Confirm your desktop display settings so your companion can appear immediately.", "Allow desktop overlay permission", "Enable multi-monitor support"]
3: ["Sign In to Restore Your Pets", "Connecting your account automatically syncs existing pets, cosmetics, and settings.", "Using your registered account ensures existing pets are never lost.", "Automatic Cloud Backup Enabled"]
4: ["Preset pets load instantly (~30 sec), while custom photo pets take ~2 mins to render."]
5: ["Initializing Desktop Engine", "We are preparing your pet's animation assets and placing them on your desktop overlay.", "Loading desktop overlay assets..."]
6: ["Official Adoption Certificate", "Name your new desktop companion and receive a free starter care kit.", "Includes Free Starter Toy"]
7: ["Your Pet is Ready on Your Screen!", "Right-click your pet anytime to open controls. Use Alt+P to show or hide your companion.", "Drag your pet anywhere on screen to reposition them."]
8: ["Welcome to Desktop Pets", "Sign in to activate cloud save and access your pets across devices."]
9: ["Choose How to Create Your Pet", "Swipe to explore instant pre-made pets or generate a custom companion."]
